newsitem.title: USA: ComEd nuke seen at full output this week.
newsitem.headline: ComEd nuke seen at full output this week.

text.p: Commonwealth Edison Co's 789 megawatt Quad Cities nuclear power unit 1 will likely return to full output this week following a reduction for repairs, a company spokesman said Monday.
"It should be back at a full load later this week," said spokesman Gary Wald.
Power output at the Cordova, Ill. unit was reduced to near 50 percent over the weekend for repairs to a steam seal system, Wald said.
Power was expected to be held near 50 percent during the repairs, the spokesman said.
Quad Cities unit 2, also at Cordova with a capacity 789 megawatts, was operating normally at full output Monday, Wald said.
Commonwealth Edison is a subsidiary of Unicom Corp.
-- Chris Reese, New York Power Desk 212-859-1627
